chrome.help: Hover an element to see what it does

children.name: GeneralTab
children.help: Language, mod UI translation, and general behavior

children.name: EnableTranslationsToggle
children.help: Turn the mod's translations on or off. When off, the game shows its original text.

children.name: TranslateModUIToggle
children.help: Translate this mod's own buttons and labels into your target language, alongside the game's text.

children.name: ModUIHint
children.text: Translate this mod's own buttons and labels

children.name: InterfaceFont
children.help: Font for this mod's interface when it is translated. Only fonts usable by the interface are listed; pick one that supports your target language's characters.

children.name: NotifEnabledToggle
children.help: Show small corner messages for sync, updates, and translation activity. Turn off for clean screenshots.

children.name: NotifPosition
children.help: Which screen corner the notification overlay appears in.

children.name: DebugLoggingToggle
children.help: Write detailed logs to the mod log file. Turn on when reporting an issue, then share the log. Off by default.

children.name: DebugAiToggle
children.help: Log every AI request and response (prompts, raw output, placeholder handling). Verbose — use only to diagnose translation quality.

children.name: SourceLang
children.help: The language the game's text is written in. Leave on Auto to detect it automatically.

children.name: TargetLang
children.help: The language you want the game translated into. Auto uses your system language.

children.name: OpacityFocused
children.caption: Focused:
children.help: How solid the window you are working in is. Lower it to see the game through the one you are using.

children.name: OpacityUnfocused
children.caption: Others:
children.help: How solid the other windows are. Slightly faded by default, so a second window can stay open without hiding the game.

children.name: ResetWindowsBtn
children.help: Move all mod windows back to their default positions and sizes.

children.name: ReportBugBtn
children.help: Something broken? Open a GitHub issue (a free GitHub account is required)

children.name: DiscussionsBtn
children.help: Questions, ideas and feedback — talk with us and other players on GitHub

children.name: OnlineDocsBtn
children.help: The full user guide on the website (in your language)

children.name: HotkeysTab
children.help: Keyboard shortcuts for the mod's panels and tools

children.name: HotkeyHint
children.text: Press the key combination to open/close the settings panel

children.name: ExtraHotkeysHint
children.text: Optional shortcuts. All disabled by default to avoid conflicts with game controls. Click X to clear a hotkey.

children.name: HkToggleTranslationsHint
children.text: Turn all translations on/off (restores original text)

children.name: HkToggleAIHint
children.text: Pause/resume live translation - texts already translated stay translated

children.name: HkToggleImagesHint
children.text: Debug: show original images instead of replacements

children.name: HkToggleFontsHint
children.text: Debug: show the game's original fonts instead of the mod's replacement fonts

children.name: HkToggleOverlayHint
children.text: Show/hide the corner notification overlay (for clean screenshots)

children.name: HkOpenExclusionHint
children.text: Open/close the inspector in exclusion mode

children.name: HkOpenTextEditorHint
children.text: Open/close the in-game text editor (click UI text to edit)

children.name: HkForceScanHint
children.text: Re-scan the current scene (useful after scene glitches)

children.name: AdaptationTab
children.help: How the mod behaves alongside the game — set it for this game, and for whether you are playing or translating

children.name: CaptureLabel
children.text: While a mod window is open

children.name: CaptureIntro
children.text: Stop the game from reacting behind the window. Turn one off if it interferes with this game.

children.name: CaptureKeyboard
children.help: Keys go to this window only. Without it, typing a translation also walks, shoots or opens the game's menus. Turn it off if the game stops answering the keyboard the way it should.

children.name: CaptureKeyboardFocusOnly
children.text: Only while the mod's interface has focus
children.help: The game keeps its keyboard until you type in a field or move through this interface with the keyboard. Turn it off if what you type does not reach the mod in this game — the keyboard is then taken the whole time a window is open.

children.name: KeyboardFocusHint
children.text: The game keeps its keys until you type or navigate here. If what you type never reaches the mod, turn this one off.

children.name: CaptureGameMenus
children.text: Take clicks from the game's menus
children.help: The game's own buttons and menus stop answering the pointer. Clicks inside this window never reach them either way — this is about the rest of the screen.

children.name: CaptureGameClicks
children.text: Take clicks from the game itself
children.help: The game stops reading clicks for what it does on its own — shooting, interacting, dragging. Without it, clicking beside this window still acts in the game.

children.name: CaptureMouseAxes
children.help: Stops the camera turning while you use the window. Mostly matters in first-person games.

children.name: MouseCaptureHint
children.text: To hold the view still while the game's own menus keep working: take mouse movement, and leave the two above off.

children.name: PauseGameToggle
children.text: Freeze the game while this window is open
children.help: The game stops on the current frame; hovering and picking still work.

children.name: PauseWhy
children.text: Off by default: what it does depends on the game. Some ignore it entirely, others cope badly with being frozen. Try it — nothing is changed permanently.

children.name: PauseDanger
children.text: Do not use this in a multiplayer game. The game's server does not stop: your character stays exposed and your session can desynchronise. Some anti-cheat systems also treat this as cheating.

children.name: DisableEventSystemToggle
children.text: Let the game handle its own interface input
children.help: Stop the mod from taking the game's EventSystem. Turn on if the game's own menus stop reacting — losing their hover or their selection cursor — while a mod window is open.

children.name: EventSystemHint
children.text: Turn on if the game's menus stop reacting while a mod window is open.

children.name: TranslationTab
children.help: How untranslated texts get translated: your AI, Google or DeepL

children.name: CaptureKeysToggle
children.help: Record every text the game shows into your translation file as empty entries, to translate later. No automatic translation happens.

children.name: ManualModeHint
children.text: Every text the game shows is added to your translation file as an empty entry, so you can translate it later (in-game editor or browser)

children.name: EnableTransBackendToggle
children.help: Automatically translate untranslated texts using the backend below (your AI, Google or DeepL). Turning this off pauses translation and keeps everything below as it is, so you can set it up first and start when you are ready.

children.name: BackendTypeDropdown
children.help: AI: your own model (Ollama, LM Studio, ChatGPT...) with full context. Google / DeepL: classic translation services, needs an API key.

children.name: AIUrl
children.help: Address of your AI server, for example a local Ollama or LM Studio. Default is http://127.0.0.1:11434.

children.name: TestBtn
children.help: Check that the mod can reach the AI server at the URL above.

children.name: AIApiKey
children.help: API key for your AI server, if it needs one. Leave empty for most local servers.

children.name: KeyHint
children.text: Optional for local servers (Ollama, LM Studio)

children.name: ModelDropdown
children.help: Which AI model handles the translations. Use Refresh to load the list from your server.

children.name: RefreshBtn
children.help: Load the list of available models from your AI server.

children.name: ModelHint
children.text: Select a model from your server

children.name: ContextInput
children.placeholder: e.g., RPG game with medieval setting
children.help: Optional note about the game (genre, setting, tone) to help the AI pick better wording.

children.name: ContextHint
children.text: Helps the AI understand game vocabulary

children.name: StrictSourceToggle
children.help: Skip texts that are not in the source language, so foreign or already-translated text is left alone. AI backend only.

children.name: StrictHint
children.text: Skip texts not matching source language (LLM only)

children.name: AttemptsHint
children.text: How many requests one line may cost at most — used both to repair a broken placeholder and to retranslate a line you did not like

children.name: MaxAttempts
children.caption: Attempts:
children.help: Each attempt is a real request to your AI. 1 means never ask twice. Default 3.

children.name: TempHint
children.text: Temperature: 0 always gives the same answer for the same line, higher wanders further from it

children.name: Temp
children.caption: Translating:
children.help: Ordinary translation. Zero by default so the same line always gets the same translation — the file is cached, shared and merged with other people's.

children.name: TempRepair
children.caption: Repairing:
children.help: Used when the answer broke a [!v*0]-style marker and has to be asked again. Just above zero: the same request would return the same broken answer.

children.name: TempRetrans
children.caption: Retranslating:
children.help: Used by the Retranslate button, when you did not like the translation. High on purpose: same instructions, different wording.

children.name: SeedHint
children.text: Seed: leave empty unless you want the same run twice. Many servers accept it and ignore it

children.name: Seed
children.caption: Translating:
children.help: Fixed seed for ordinary translation. Empty sends none.

children.name: SeedRepair
children.caption: Repairing:
children.help: Fixed seed when re-asking after a broken marker. Empty sends none.

children.name: SeedRetrans
children.caption: Retranslating:
children.help: Fixed seed for the Retranslate button. It is offset by the attempt number, so retranslating still varies — a single fixed seed would hand back the answer you just rejected, every time. Empty draws a new one each attempt.

children.name: ProviderDropdown
children.help: Choose the translation service: Google Translate or DeepL. Each needs its own API key.

children.name: GoogleApiKey
children.help: Your Google Cloud API key with the Translation API enabled.

children.name: GoogleTestBtn
children.help: Send a test request to check that your Google API key works.

children.name: GoogleHint
children.text: Requires a Google Cloud API key with Translation API enabled

children.name: DeepLApiKey
children.help: Your DeepL API key (Free or Pro).

children.name: DeepLTestBtn
children.help: Send a test request to check that your DeepL API key works.

children.name: DeepLFreeToggle
children.help: Use the DeepL Free endpoint. Turn off if you have a DeepL Pro key.

children.name: DeepLHint
children.text: Uncheck for Pro API (api.deepl.com). Free plan: 500k chars/month

children.name: RateLimitDelay
children.help: How long to wait before retrying when the translation service asks the mod to slow down.

children.name: RateLimitHint
children.text: How long to wait before retrying when the translation service asks to slow down

children.name: OnlineTab
children.help: Website sync, update notifications, and network settings

children.name: OnlineModeToggle
children.help: On: the mod contacts our website to find community translations and updates for your games. Off: fully offline, nothing leaves your machine.

children.name: RealtimeOwnToggle
children.text: Real-time check for your own translation
children.help: Keeps a connection open so that what you publish from the website, or from another computer, comes back to the game as it happens. Only ever about your own line: contributions you receive and the original you contribute to follow the rhythm below. Nothing is opened when you have published nothing of your own.

children.name: RealtimeOwnHint
children.text: Changes you publish from the website or another machine come back straight away, rather than waiting for the next check.

children.name: CheckFrequency
children.help: How often the mod asks the website what changed: contributions waiting for your review if you own a translation, the original translation if you contribute to someone else's, and a newer version of the translation you use. Your own line is in here too, unless Real-time check is on. Editing in the browser is a separate, instant channel and is never affected by this setting.

children.name: CheckFreqHint
children.text: Contributions you received, a Main that moved, a newer version published — and your own translation when Real-time check is off.

children.name: CheckFreqStartupHint
children.text: Every option except Never also checks once when the game starts.

children.name: NotifyToggle
children.help: Show a notification when a newer version of a translation is available to download.

children.name: AutoDownloadToggle
children.help: Only applies when you have no local changes — otherwise the mod always asks first

children.name: RestoreSettingsBtn
children.help: Compare your fonts, exclusions and other file settings with the online version, and choose section by section which ones to take back. Nothing changes until you press Apply.

children.name: ModUpdatesToggle
children.help: Check for a new version of the mod itself when the game starts.

children.name: CheckNowBtn
children.help: Check for a new mod version right now.

children.name: PrereleaseToggle
children.help: Also get notified about beta (pre-release) mod versions, not just stable ones.

children.name: PrereleaseHint
children.text: Betas are early builds for testing new features. Leave off to only hear about stable releases.

children.name: ProxyIntro
children.text: Use only if the mod's network calls hang (game intercepts HTTP). Keep Default otherwise.

children.name: ProxyModeDropdown
children.help: How the mod connects to the internet. Keep Default unless the game blocks the mod's network calls.

children.name: ProxyUrl
children.help: Address of your proxy server, used only in Custom mode.

children.name: ProxyUser
children.help: Proxy username, if your proxy requires sign-in. Optional.

children.name: ProxyPass
children.help: Proxy password, if your proxy requires sign-in. Optional.

children.name: ProxyBypassToggle
children.text: Bypass proxy for localhost / private addresses
children.help: Connect directly to local and private addresses instead of through the proxy.
